title: Blue Yodels, Teen Prodigies, and A Musical Rabbit Hole
content: Curious about how Blue Yodels, Jimmy Rodgers and a wild young yodeler named Whitey McPherson fit into the early roots of country/jazz/Western swing? Then click on this MetaFilter thread that dives into classic Rodgers clips, rare Rhythm Wreckers recordings, and how all this early yodel-infused stuff helped shape American music history. Bring your earphones and welcome in the New Year!
author: Brandon Blatcher
